description.value: The Outsider racial HD and native defense fields carry the traits of this creature type; see the individual subtypes and exceptions.
Ser Charibert (Knights of the Round) does not breathe.
Ser Charibert (Knights of the Round) does not eat.
Ser Charibert (Knights of the Round) does not sleep.

3/day, Ser Charibert can use his knowledge of the elements and shield allies for a brief duration. As an immediate action, he can shield himself and allies within 30 feet from elemental damage, gaining Elemental Resistance 20 to all elements (earth, fire, ice, lightning, water, and wind) until the start of his next turn.

effect: 3/day, Ser Charibert can use his knowledge of the elements and shield allies for a brief duration. As an immediate action, he can shield himself and allies within 30 feet from elemental damage, gaining Elemental Resistance 20 to all elements (earth, fire, ice, lightning, water, and wind) until the start of his next turn.

description.value: Once every 1d3+1 rounds as a standard action, Ser Charibert places 30-ft.-radius red puddles underneath each target within 240-feet away from him. The puddles deal 8d8 points of fire damage unless they make a Reflex save (DC 37) for half damage. This leaves red puddles of flames on the ground where each target was standing on for five more rounds after dealing 6d6 points of fire damage per round while anyone is on that space.

effect: Once every 1d3+1 rounds as a standard action, Ser Charibert places 30-ft.-radius red puddles underneath each target within 240-feet away from him. The puddles deal 8d8 points of fire damage unless they make a Reflex save (DC 37) for half damage. This leaves red puddles of flames on the ground where each target was standing on for five more rounds after dealing 6d6 points of fire damage per round while anyone is on that space.
For the next five rounds. No second initial save or recharge.

description.value: Once every other round as a standard action, Ser Charibert links a divine chain between two targets within 120-ft. away that must be 30 feet apart. Those two are tethered together take 4d6 points of (half fire/holy) damage per round until they're at least 60 feet apart. They can make a Fortitude save (DC 35) per round to half the damage taken. This ability cannot be dispel or cured.

effect: Once every other round as a standard action, Ser Charibert links a divine chain between two targets within 120-ft. away that must be 30 feet apart. Those two are tethered together take 4d6 points of (half fire/holy) damage per round until they're at least 60 feet apart. They can make a Fortitude save (DC 35) per round to half the damage taken. This ability cannot be dispel or cured.
Repeat on both tethered targets until they separate by at least 60 feet.

description.value: Once every 1d2+1 rounds as a standard action, Ser Charibert shoots out a blast of lava from his hand within 30 feet. He must make a ranged touch attack to hit, and if the ray hits, it deals 16d6 points of fire damage and the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 35) or be inflicted with Burning and Entrangled status effects. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 7th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 29).

description.value: Ser Charibert can use power weapons as if they had MP.

This 1-handed mid-ranked rod allows the wielder to shoot elemental energy at a target. When created or bought, they only deal one elemental type of damage (Earth, Fire, Holy, Ice, Lightning, Shadow, Water, or Wind) and are named as such (Fire Rod, Ice Rod, etc). They have 5 Hardness and HP 5.
